name: CopyVec3
evidence: copies the three floats at +0, +4 and +8 of its second argument into its first

name: CopyVec2
evidence: copies the two floats at +0 and +4 of its second argument into its first

name: UpdateTriangleAnimatorCursor
evidence: slot 4 of the triangle animator method table D_0021E418: finds where the segment between two linked objects' points crosses the triangle strip of its points, takes the texture coordinates there and eases the cursor's u and v toward them within the clamps

name: MapCharToCode
evidence: maps one byte of a string to a 16-bit character code by its range (the punctuation from 0x20 up first); ConvertStringToCharCodes calls it for each byte

name: ConvertStringToCharCodes
evidence: maps each byte of a string through func_001B5B58, swaps the two bytes of the result into a 16-bit unit and ends the output with 0

name: StartCameraPositionedObject
evidence: slot 16 (start) of class 0x54: StartPlacedObject, then clears flag bits 40 and 41 and sets bit 40

name: MoveObjectToCamera
evidence: slot 17 (update) of class 0x54: UpdatePlacedObject, then sets its position (slot 29) to the camera's vector at +0x40, keeping its own height unless +0x2D0 is set

name: BuildFreeList
evidence: stores the stride in word 0, then chains count nodes at that stride from the base in word 1 (each node's first word points to the next) and ends the chain with 0; the two pool initialisers call it

name: InitSlotPool
evidence: rounds the slot size up to 8, allocates size times count bytes with func_0018D500 into word 1 and chains them with BuildFreeList

name: InitAlignedSlotPool
evidence: allocates size times count plus 0x30 bytes, aligns the base up to 0x40 and chains the slots with BuildFreeList

name: PopFreeSlot
evidence: takes the node at the pool's head (+8), moves the head to its next word and returns the node (0 when empty)

name: TakePoolSlot
evidence: PopFreeSlot on a pool: the node allocators of contact rows, attach and call records and touch nodes (PushContactRow, TakeAttachRecord, TakeCallRecord, AllocateTouchNode) and CopyPlacedObject call it

name: PopZeroedFreeSlot
evidence: PopFreeSlot, then clears the slot with func_001F5C0C over the pool's slot size (+0); func_001B6290 takes its handle this way

name: PushFreeSlot
evidence: puts a non-null item back at the head of the pool (+8) by storing the old head in its first word; func_001B6438 returns the handle to the world's pool with it

name: LoadStateGraph
evidence: slot 10 (load) of class 0x88: reads the graph's state table (keys, FindStateEntryIndexOrZero) and its edges with their vectors from the stream onto front memory

name: StartStateGraph
evidence: slot 16 (start) of class 0x88: StartObject, and when the graph is armed (+0x44) queues SpawnInitialStateWalker on the world

name: SpawnInitialStateWalker
evidence: takes the first non-empty slot at +0x40, looks up the object named by its value at +0x40 with func_0015A448 and creates a walker (func_001B6290) on it with key -1

name: CreateStateWalker
evidence: takes a zeroed handle from the world's pool (func_001B5EE0), stores its table D_002198E8, owner and arguments, links it into the world's list and the owner's, sets its index from the key with FindStateEntryIndex, plans its first move with func_001B66A0 and sends event 0x11

name: FindListNodeByKey
evidence: walks the owner's list from head and returns the first node whose key equals the argument, else 0

name: FindStateEntryIndex
evidence: scans the 8-byte entries at +0x38 (count at +0x34) for one whose first word equals the key and returns its index, or -1

name: FindStateEntryIndexOrZero
evidence: FindStateEntryIndex with a result below 0 turned into 0

name: GetStateEntryKey
evidence: returns the first word of entry index (8 bytes each) of the table at +0x38

name: DestroyStateWalker
evidence: frees the handle's object at +0x24 and its entry in the world, removes it from the owner's and the world's lists, returns it to the pool with PushFreeSlot and sends event 0x12

name: SetStateWalkerTarget
evidence: sets the target index (+0x30) from a key (-1 for none); when it changes and the current track allows it (flag 2) drops the running track, and plans a move with func_001B66A0 if none is running

name: GetStateWalkerTargetKey
evidence: stores the key of the walker's target state (+0x30) in the graph's state table, or -1 for none

name: GetStateWalkerCurrentKey
evidence: stores the key of the walker's current state (+0x28) in the graph's state table, or -1 for none

name: GetStateWalkerNextKey
evidence: stores the key of the state the walker is moving to (+0x2C) in the graph's state table, or -1 for none

name: SetStateWalkerSpeed
evidence: stores the walker's speed at +0x38 and tells the animation player at +0x24 when there is one (SetAnimationPlayerSpeed)

name: TeleportStateWalker
evidence: finds the entry index of the key and, unless the walker is already there, notifies the change (func_001B6E28), makes it both its current and target index, clears +0x2C and plans again with func_001B66A0

name: StartNextStateWalkerEdge
evidence: breadth-first numbers the graph's nodes from the current one toward the target over the edge list, picks among the first-step edges by their weights with RandomFloatInRange, steps over edges without a track and starts the chosen edge's track with func_0012C7B0 (ending with callback func_001B6CA8); with no route clears the edge and calls func_001B6D78 with 0x14

name: CommitStateWalkerArrival
evidence: notifies the change from the current to the target index (func_001B6E28), then makes the target the current index and sets the target to -1

name: HandleStateWalkerTrackEnd
evidence: callback of the edge's track: for message 5 aimed at its own track commits the arrival (func_001B6C68) and plans the next edge (func_001B66A0)

name: AdvanceStateWalkerTime
evidence: spends a time on the running track: while the time is at least the track's remaining length commits the arrival and plans the next edge, else steps the track by the rest with func_0012F0A0

name: CallStateWalkerListeners
evidence: calls slot 18 of the object at +0x1C, then calls each (function, object) record of the list at +0x3C with the two arguments

name: AddStateWalkerListener
evidence: adds a (function, object) record to the state walker's listener list at +0x3C (AddCallbackNode on its holder's world), the list CallStateWalkerListeners calls; BlendParamSets, StartGaugeCollider and StartTempoAgent call it

name: NotifyStateWalkerChange
evidence: looks up the values of two entry indexes (-1 for a negative one) and sends event 0xE with the walker and both values to the owner (func_001837E0)

name: InitCompanionAgent
evidence: slot 0 of class 0x09: InitAgent, then its ranges 0xC18..0xC24 (300, 2000), the id 0xC28 and the companion id 0xC10 set to -1 and the 17 look entries cleared to -1

name: ResolveCompanionAgentObjects
evidence: looks the 17 per-state look ids at 0xC38 up into their objects, keeps of the objects of key 0x60 the one matching the id at 0xC10 as its companion (0xC14) and calls slot 7 of the others, then attaches a pose source (CreatePoseSource) to the companion at 0xC34

name: SetCompanionAgentLookId
evidence: stores the id of the object to look at in state index (the 8-byte entries at 0xC38) after IsAgentSlotIndex; the script built-in func_00105658 calls it

name: AddCompanionAgentExcludedId
evidence: script built-in: appends an id to the list at 0xCD8 (count 0xCD4, at most 4) that StartCompanionAgent resolves and IsCompanionAgentBlocker leaves out

name: StartCompanionAgent
evidence: slot 16 (start) of class 0x09: StartAgent, ResolveCompanionAgentObjects, then looks the id 0xC28 up into 0xC2C and each excluded id (0xCD8) into its object

name: IsCompanionAgentBlocker
evidence: the filter func_001B7280 passes to its query: refuses an object with bit 43 of +0x538, one whose root is of kind 5 or 0x4C, and one under an excluded object (IsObjectDescendantOf); accepts the rest

name: IsCompanionAgentTargetReachable
evidence: original VU0 code: slot 0x16C of class 0x09 (IsAgentFree's slot), the second test of IsCompanionAgentTargetInRange; returns 0 when the agent is busy, has no target or the player is untargetable (IsPlayerUntargetableByAgent), or when a collider (IsCompanionAgentBlocker, found by GatherCollidersInBox) lies in the box around its path to the target; as a side effect it pushes a sound level and steers its companion and look objects; returns 1 otherwise

name: UpdateCompanionAgent
evidence: slot 17 (update) of class 0x09: UpdateAgent, then AimCompanionAgentPose

name: AimCompanionAgentPose
evidence: by the roster state (GetAgentRosterState) points the companion's pose source (0xC34) at the state's look object (0xC30), the agent's target (slot 98, SelectAgentTarget) or the agent itself, and sets the companion's rate +0x2F0 to 1.0, 1.3 or 0.1

name: EnterCompanionAgentState
evidence: slot 92 of class 0x09: EnterAgentState, then clears the count 0xCC4 in state 6, releases the companion (slot 7) and its sound level in state 0xB, and takes the state's look object into 0xC30

name: IsCompanionAgentTargetInRange
evidence: slot 0x184 of class 0x09: IsAgentTargetInRange and then its slot 0x16C (func_001B7280)

name: AnswerCompanionAgentRosterPoll
evidence: slot 0x170 of class 0x09 (AnswerAgentRosterPoll's slot): 1 in state 0xB, in state 6 with a count at 0xCC4 2 after five seconds in the state and 1 before, else 0

name: HandleCompanionAgentNotification
evidence: slot 13 of class 0x09: HandleAgentNotification, then counts at 0xCC4 each notification 7 about its animation player 0x7E0

name: SetCompanionAgentFrozen
evidence: slot 20 of class 0x09: SetColliderFrozen, and when freezing releases the sound level at 0xCC0
